contribution_types.description:
Chloe (_canadian, anthropologist by training, an activist of gender equality, social and environmental justice_) spent 30 minutes surfacing importance of 

*Subject matter 1: taking into account invisible work that is often performed by women folk* that is not accounted for in the economy which prevents them from fully contributing into the tokenized part of the economy 

- childcare 
- ⁠domestic finance management such as ensuring the men in the house not spend all the household money on alcohol which is common in Latin America

*Subject matter 2: Problem of ethics* when interfacing with the Indigenous community 

- ⁠when interfacing with the indigenous community in @⁨<guild>[project] SunMint Guild⁩ ensure we do not inadvertently steer them in a direction that cause them to change the fauna on the tribal land and introduce imbalance

*Subject matter 3: relevance of TrueSight DAO variant of tokenomics* to NGO organizations addressing social and environment justice. Organizations surfaced include 

- https://www.oxfam.org.br/
- ⁠https://suco.org/ <This message was edited>
Chloe spent 5 minutes responding to the question of Itacare history as a black escaped slaves refuge, a quilombo <This message was edited>
